notes: needs_ruling (rule 11): «وروى الزهري الكلام الأول عن سعيد فأرسله» names another transmitter for the same saying and says it was cut short, the same kind as «ورواه X عن Y فلم يرفعه»; not written as a route
«- وهو ابن ميمون -» is an editor's gloss, left out; «محمد» is the second of the same name, occurrence 2
